Conflict Card: Rule A vs Rule B

Input: buffer_full is true and blackout is true, in context science.

Rule A - Transmit telemetry when the onboard buffer is full - applies and requires action: transmit.

Rule B - Hold transmissions during a communications blackout - applies and requires action: hold.

The required actions transmit and hold are incompatible and cannot both be done.

Which rule should win for this input?
